result.summary: The page is largely intact, but the bottom navigation is visibly broken by an overlapping system/gesture bar. Some horizontally scrollable content is also clipped without a strong scroll affordance.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal system/gesture indicator is positioned across the bottom navigation, overlapping the Search and Saved icons and making them look struck through.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device safe-area inset and place the gesture indicator below the app navigation. Add sufficient bottom padding so navigation icons never overlap system UI.

issues.description: The category chips and the “Fastest near you” cards are abruptly cut off at the right edge, including partially visible content and text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure these rows are intentionally horizontally scrollable, add consistent trailing padding, and use a clearer partial-card treatment or scroll affordance so the clipping does not appear accidental.
